description: This file defines models and functions related to widget editor completions in the Thingsboard project, including a function to generate code completions for widget editors and an export for a completer object.

classes.name: TbEditorCompleter
classes.description: A class representing a code editor completer for widget editing.

methods.name: widgetEditorCompletions
methods.description: Generates code completion suggestions for widget editor, optionally including provided settings completions.

methods.name: widgetEditorCompleter
methods.description: Creates a new TbEditorCompleter instance initialized with widget editor completions.
